info.name: Sockless Mail
info.summary: Webmail client for Nextcloud with multiple IMAP/SMTP accounts per user
info.description: Sockless Mail is a webmail client that runs as a Nextcloud External App (AppAPI). Each user can connect any number of IMAP/SMTP accounts. The backend is written in C# on ASP.NET Core.
info.author: Jimmy Everling

variable.name: SOCKLESS_MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variable.description: Protects the key ring that encrypts stored mail account passwords. At least 32 characters. Keep it outside backups of the app's data volume. See the README, "Security model".

variable.name: SOCKLESS_MAIL_ALLOW_LOCAL_SERVERS
variable.display-name: Allow mail servers on local networks
variable.description: "true" lets users connect to mail servers on private, loopback or carrier-grade NAT addresses (for an internal mail server). Off by default, so users cannot probe the network the app runs in.
